summary: Validate a clean published integration against its actual preceding target revision

delivery.outcome: Publish a standard update that validates a clean target integration against its supplied first-parent base, retaining pre-merge and stale-base conflict protection.
nonGoals: No bypass of conflicts, digest verification, protected delivery or physical hardware interlocks.

architecture.decision: Only a clean HEAD equal to the observed target with the supplied base equal to its first parent is an already-published integration. Validate accepted-to-supplied-base drift while excluding that integration from intervening target changes; otherwise retain conservative behavior.
interfaceChanges: The existing governance checker accepts a clean published integration with its exact first-parent base while retaining pre-merge drift checks.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material fix through protected publication.

validation.evidence: Real Git histories for published integrations, stale bases, dirty trees and ambiguous observations.
Pending package validation and protected publication.
